Subject: Recap + one micro question on rollout window

Hi Samir,

Thanks again for your time today — appreciated the candid discussion about your inference needs. Quick recap and the one micro question at the end.

Call recap
- Goal: reduce per-token inference cost for recommendation reranks and get sub-250ms tail latency for 512-token prompts
- Current infra: mixed on-prem GPU fleet + GCP for batch scoring
- Success criteria: pilot demonstrating 30% cost reduction with <15% accuracy delta on rerank tasks
- Constraints: can't route PII-sensitive traffic off-prem until KMS/HSM integration is validated

Proposed next steps
1) 2-week pilot on a reserved Redwood Dedicated pool (we provide a small test model + guidance)
2) You share one representative dataset (sanitized); Marissa will own data ingest and test harness
3) Redwood provides a short eval report and cost projection

Micro question
- Is there a firm window you’re targeting for an internal rollout (Nov, Dec, Q1)? That helps us size the pilot SLA and engineer availability.

Attaching the discovery notes and the rough SOW sketch.

Attachment: discovery-notes-redwood.pdf (pdf, 78KB)

If Nov is feasible, we can fast-track a minimal pilot plan. If timing slipped to Q1, totally fine — just say the word and we’ll align.

Best,

Logan Wright
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
